architecture.discovery: No existing i18n framework (no next-intl/i18next) was found scoped to the Gallery Hero or storefront app source. A lightweight, dependency-free dictionary module was implemented at packages/gallery-experience/src/i18n/dictionary.ts rather than installing a new library, per Section 12 instruction to prefer the existing architecture.
architecture.locale_source: GalleryHeroClient resolves locale from the Next.js [countryCode] route param via resolveGalleryLocale(countryCode).
architecture.lang_attribute: Set on the gallery root element: <div data-gallery-experience lang={locale}>.

route_dk.reason: countryCode 'dk' has no explicit locale mapping (Denmark is a Medusa region, not a language signal); falls back to DEFAULT_GALLERY_LOCALE.

route_es.reason: 'es' is a real, configured Medusa region/country (Spain) used here as the available test path for the es-419 branch; canonical target audience is Latin American Spanish per the copy table.

gallery.brand.note: Brand name intentionally not translated per Section 12 rule.

gallery.previous.note: Defined for matrix completeness. Not bound to a visible control: BB-04 static first-fold has no prev/next navigation controls in scope (dynamic navigation is explicitly out of scope per Section 3).

gallery.next.note: Same as gallery.previous - defined, not yet bound (no nav controls in static first-fold).

gallery.viewDetails.note: Defined per Section 12 canonical copy. NOT bound to the visible CTA: the CTA's existing literal copy 'Conhecer a peça' is treated as fixed brand messaging (like gallery.brand), consistent with the Section 12 rule 'não inventar CTAs comerciais'. Flagged in Human Decision Brief for product/brand review.

gallery.scene.profile.rendered_element: .dtc-gallery__scene img[title] (scene rail thumbnail 1, accessible title attribute)

gallery.productCounter.note: Defined per Section 12 canonical copy but NOT bound to the visible counter element. Section 2 (hard gate) requires the counter to render exactly '01 / 06' regardless of locale; binding this template would break that gate. The dictionary key is implemented and available for future use once the gate contract changes.

text_expansion_note: es-419 tagline ('El crochet se mueve', 20 chars) is comparable in length to pt-BR ('O crochê se move', 16 chars); no observed wrapping/overflow regressions in the .dtc-gallery__collection-narrative max-width:280px container across any of the 5 captured viewports.
